beef-rendang-rice.title: Beef rendang with rice and cucumber yoghurt
ing: 125 g microwave brown rice cup, split in half
Grated or diced cucumber, squeeze of lime, salt
steps: Heat the rendang as per the pack.
Microwave the rice cups.
Mix the yoghurt with cucumber, lime and salt.
Serve the rendang over rice with the dressing and salad.
beef-rendang-rice.notes:
Split 60% Scott / 40% Leigh.
Scott: 300g rendang + half rice + dressing ≈ 715 cal / 46g protein. Leigh: 200g rendang + half rice + dressing ≈ 515 cal / 31g.
Rendang is high in saturated fat; the yoghurt and salad balance it.

berry-protein-smoothie.title: Berry mango banana protein smoothie
ing: 170 g high-protein Greek yoghurt (or 70g high-protein cottage cheese)
steps: Add everything with water and ice to about 1.2 L.
Blend on speed 9 for 60-90 seconds.
Pour Leigh's cups first, then Scott's share.
Keep any afternoon cup in the fridge and shake before drinking (the chia thickens it).
berry-protein-smoothie.notes:
Makes ~1.2 L (whole batch = 1 serve here).
Usual split: Leigh 2 × 250ml (~150 cal / 14g each), Scott the rest (~365-420 cal).
Cottage cheese version is a bit lighter (~670 cal batch).

chilli-lime-salad-chicken.title: Chilli lime salad with rotisserie chicken
ing: 1 Woolworths Chilli Lime Salad Kit (use half the dressing and half the noodles)
Optional: 125g microwave brown rice cup (+250 cal)
steps: Toss the salad with half the dressing and half the noodles.
Top with the shredded chicken.
chilli-lime-salad-chicken.notes:
Shared: Scott 2/3 (~420 cal / 40g), Leigh 1/3 (~210 cal / 20g).
Solo: whole kit + 110g chicken ≈ 475 cal / 36g.

choc-berry-protein-smoothie.title: Choc berry protein smoothie
ing: Good handful of ice, then water to ~1.25 L
steps: Add everything, using more ice and less water if the banana isn't frozen.
Blend on speed 9 for 60-90 seconds.
Shake any cup kept for later (the chia thickens it).
choc-berry-protein-smoothie.notes:
Makes ~1.25-1.5 L. 500ml ≈ 250-300 cal.
Salt and vanilla make the chocolate pop. Options: espresso shot for mocha, orange zest, 1 tbsp PB (+95 cal) or PB2 (+45).

choc-pb-banana-smoothie.title: Choc peanut butter banana smoothie
ing: 1 tbsp peanut butter (or 2 tbsp PB2 powder, saves ~45 cal)
steps: Add everything with water and ice to about 1.2 L.
Blend on speed 9 for 60-90 seconds.
Pour Leigh's cups first, then Scott's share.
choc-pb-banana-smoothie.notes:
Usual split: Leigh 500ml (~310 cal / 30g), Scott 700ml (~440 cal / 41g).
Feels like a treat; good after polo. Frozen bananas and more ice for creaminess.

cottage-cheese-egg-bake.title: Cottage cheese egg bake
ing: The Recipe Well cottage cheese egg bake base
Half the cheddar the recipe calls for
steps: Make The Recipe Well's cottage cheese egg bake with half the cheddar and oil spray.
Add the broccoli and mushrooms.
Cut into 6 serves.
cottage-cheese-egg-bake.notes:
1 serve ≈ 345 cal / 29g. Leigh usually has a half serve.
Good with sriracha. Keeps for the week.
Bacon + zucchini version (no broccoli, for Leigh): 200g bacon, 1 zucchini ≈ 370 cal / 32g a serve.

green-pineapple-kiwi-smoothie.title: Green pineapple kiwi smoothie
steps: Add everything with water and ice to about 1.2 L.
Blend on speed 9 for 60-90 seconds.
Pour Leigh's cups first, then Scott's share.
green-pineapple-kiwi-smoothie.notes: Usual split: Leigh 500ml (~315 cal), Scott 700ml (~440 cal). You can't taste the spinach.

mocha-smoothie.title: Mocha protein smoothie
steps: Let the espresso cool for a few minutes.
Add everything with water and ice to about 1.2 L.
Blend on speed 9 for 60-90 seconds.
Pour Leigh's cups first, then Scott's share.
mocha-smoothie.notes: Usual split: Leigh 500ml (~275 cal), Scott 700ml (~385 cal). Swap some water for oat milk for creamier (+~55 cal per 100ml).

paprika-chicken-sweet-potato.title: Paprika chicken, sweet potato mash, greens and cashew cream
ing: Broccolini or asparagus, plus green beans
steps: Thermomix: paprika chicken with steamed sweet potato mash, steamed greens and cashew cream, using oil spray instead of ghee.
paprika-chicken-sweet-potato.notes:
1/3 ≈ 535 cal / 58g with cashew cream, ~460 without. Lots of cashew cream left over.
Marked: wouldn't make again.

pulled-pork-couscous-bowls.title: Pulled pork bowls with couscous and charred veg
ing: 80 g dry couscous, wholemeal if you can (50g Scott, 30g Leigh)
Stock for the couscous, lemon zest, parsley or coriander
100 g high-protein Greek yoghurt, lime juice, crushed garlic, salt (dressing)
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C. Trim the fat cap off the pork and rub it all over with the spice mix.
Brown the pork on all sides in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat with a little oil spray, 8-10 minutes.
Add the vinegar and stock (about a third of the way up the meat), put the lid on and braise in the oven for 4-5 hours, turning once halfway and topping up with water if it looks dry.
Take the lid off for the last 30 minutes to brown the top. It's done when it pulls apart easily with a fork.
Lift out the pork, discard the bone and fat, and shred. Skim the fat off the juices and stir a few spoons back through.
While the pork rests, roast the capsicum and zucchini at 220°C for 25-30 minutes until charred.
Pour boiling stock over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff with lemon zest and herbs.
Whisk the yoghurt with lime, garlic and salt.
Build bowls: cos and cucumber, couscous, charred veg, pork, dressing, pickled onion.
pulled-pork-couscous-bowls.notes:
Calories here are the pork only (~900g pulled, ~6 serves).
Scott bowl: 150g pork ≈ 635 cal / 53g. Leigh: 100g pork ≈ 425 cal / 36g.
In the oven by ~1pm for dinner ~7pm. No cabbage (Leigh). Leftovers: burrito bowls, lettuce wraps, fried rice.

soba-fish-greens-soup.title: Soba noodle soup with white fish and greens
ing: 360 g firm white fish fillets (barramundi, snapper or cod), in large chunks
1 medium carrot, cut into thin ribbons
steps: Prep the veg: slice the mushrooms, ginger, garlic and spring onions; trim and halve the broccolini, bok choy and snow peas; peel the carrot into ribbons; pat the fish dry.
Boil the soba in unsalted water for about 4 minutes until just tender. Drain and rinse under cold water.
Heat the sesame oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the ginger, garlic and mushrooms for 2 minutes, then add the stock and simmer gently for 6 minutes.
Add the broccolini and carrot and cook for 3 minutes, until the broccolini is bright green.
Lower the heat so the broth barely bubbles. Add the fish, bok choy and snow peas and poach for 4-5 minutes until the fish flakes. Stir in the spinach for the last 30 seconds.
Turn off the heat. Whisk the miso with a ladle of hot broth, then stir it back in with the soy and citrus. Don't boil after the miso goes in.
Divide the noodles between two deep bowls, ladle over the broth, fish and veg, and top with spring onions, sesame seeds and kimchi.
soba-fish-greens-soup.notes:
≈ 500 cal / 53g a bowl. 60/40 split: Scott ~600, Leigh ~400.
Extra protein: soft-boiled egg per bowl. Miso and stock are salty — taste before adding soy.

steak-wedges-asparagus.title: Eye fillet steak, air-fried wedges and asparagus
ing: 350 g pack of 2 eye fillet steaks
steps: Air fry the wedges with oil and salt until crisp.
Cook the steaks to liking with half a tsp of oil each.
Cook the asparagus with oil spray.
steak-wedges-asparagus.notes: Scott: 1 steak, 250g potato ≈ 530 cal / 47g. Leigh: 1 steak, 150g potato ≈ 430 cal / 43g.

strawberry-mango-protein-smoothie.title: Strawberry mango protein smoothie
ing: 2 big handfuls of ice, then water to ~1.25 L
steps: Add everything with plenty of ice (no banana makes it thinner).
Blend on speed 9 for 60-90 seconds.
Shake any cup kept for later.
strawberry-mango-protein-smoothie.notes:
Makes ~1.25-1.4 L. 500ml ≈ 250-280 cal.
Add ~100g frozen berries for thickness (+40 cal). Lime or mint for a fresher version.

strawberry-oat-smoothie.title: Strawberry oat smoothie
steps: Blend the oats on their own first for 10 seconds so it isn't gritty.
Add everything else with water and ice to about 1.2 L.
Blend on speed 9 for 60-90 seconds.
Pour Leigh's cups first, then Scott's share.
strawberry-oat-smoothie.notes: Usual split: Leigh 500ml (~310 cal), Scott 700ml (~430 cal). Training-day option.

taco-mince-burrito-bowl.title: Taco mince burrito bowl
ing: 500 g 5% beef or lean turkey mince
125 g microwave brown rice cup, half each
steps: Cut capsicum into strips and zucchini into 1cm half-moons, spray with oil, add salt and a pinch of taco seasoning. Air fry at 200°C for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway.
Brown the mince in a hot pan with oil spray, add the seasoning and ~150ml water, simmer until saucy.
Mix the yoghurt with lime juice and a pinch of salt (hot sauce optional).
Build: rice and salad, then mince and veg, then corn, cheese, avocado, crema, coriander and a lime wedge.
taco-mince-burrito-bowl.notes:
Mince split (cooked weight): Scott 40%, Leigh 24%, keep 36% for a lunch.
Scott ≈ 750 cal / 62g, Leigh ≈ 565 cal / 43g. No cabbage or cauli rice for Leigh.

teriyaki-beef-mince-stir-fry.title: Teriyaki beef mince stir-fry
ing: 300 g zucchini (2 large), sliced into half-moons
200 g green beans, trimmed and halved
300 g bok choy (2 bunches), leaves separated, stems sliced
150 g carrot (1 large), cut into matchsticks
4 green shallots, green tops only, sliced
125 g microwave brown rice cup, half each
steps: Mix the cornflour with 1 tbsp of the water until smooth, then stir in the soy, mirin and honey. Set aside.
Heat 1 tsp sesame oil in a wok over high heat. Add the carrot, beans and remaining water and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the zucchini and capsicum and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until just tender. Tip into a bowl.
Add the remaining sesame oil and the mince. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain off any liquid.
Add the ginger and shallot tops for 30 seconds, then pour in the sauce and simmer for 1 minute until it thickens.
Return the vegies to the wok with the bok choy and toss for 1-2 minutes until the bok choy wilts.
Microwave the rice cup and split it in half. Serve over the rice with sesame seeds and sriracha.
teriyaki-beef-mince-stir-fry.notes:
Split 60/40: Scott ≈ 900 cal / 76g, Leigh ≈ 640 cal / 52g.
Adapted from taste.com.au with 1.5× sauce. Veg chosen to avoid broccoli, cauliflower, cabbage and snow peas for Leigh.
Edamame version: +150g edamame with the zucchini (+180 cal).

tuna-rice-bowl.title: Tuna rice bowl
ing: 185 g tin Sirena tuna in olive oil with chilli, drained
150 g bag Birds Eye Steamfresh peas, beans, corn and broccoli
steps: Microwave the rice cup and the veg bag.
Top with the drained tuna, salt-reduced soy and sriracha.
tuna-rice-bowl.notes: With sweet chilli instead of sriracha ≈ 560 cal.
